WoW: Forever

Elemental Shaman

Ranged caster mixing hard lightning casts with Shocks, interrupts and totems. Its new talents all sit at level 30 or above: Lightning OverloadLightning OverloadTalentCastInstantGives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat., EarthboundEarthboundTalentCastInstantYour Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast. and Lava BurstLava BurstLevel 40 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost165 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownYou hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.. That is the whole story of this spec in the beta.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Elemental build has been tested. One warning is specific to this spec: a widely-published level-30 Elemental build is not legal on the current client. It spends 5 points on Elemental FuryElemental FuryTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%., which Blizzard moved down to row 6 on September 24, so it now needs 26 points, not 21. That site's data predates the change, and its prose and its own screenshot disagree besides. Nothing circulating counts as a published level-30 Elemental build.

The base-damage half matters more than it reads. Forever cut base spell damage across the board and moved the power onto gear. One guide spells out the consequence: "all caster specs, and for Shaman that's Elemental, will need to constantly upgrade their gear to deal decent damage." An Elemental Shaman in stale gear is genuinely weak in a way a Classic one was not.

Icy Veins' Build A above spends the base 11 in the Elemental tree itself. Both builds are legal: the sites disagree on where the points go, not on what exists.

Totemic RecallTotemic RecallLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCastInstantReturns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall. is not the free alternative it looks like, because Blizzard says its Mana refund is bugged in beta and pays out nothing. Wowhead's case for spending in Restoration therefore stands for now. But Wowhead's split cannot be assembled at level 20 as printed. Blizzard's Known Issues list opening the Legacy System before level 25 as a bug: the "Y" hotkey works and throws LUA errors on tabs 1 and 3. The Elemental-tree points Wowhead defers to Legacy are not available until 25.

Level 30: nothing to print. No source has posted a level 30 build, and the one circulating for Elemental cannot be entered on the current client, so this page gives no level 30 order.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Haste, critical strike, Intellect, MP5, Spirit, Stamina.

Nature damage and plain spell power lead equally. Then comes "Intellect, which is how many bolts you get before you have to sit down." Take leather over cloth where the stats are otherwise equal.

Forever moved caster power from base spells onto gear, so the published advice is to "constantly upgrade". Replace pieces aggressively.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
